understanding: The task requires implementing a new, isolated read-only audit subprocess pool in lib/parallel.ps1. This pool must be completely separate from existing worktree/merge functions, using per-job temporary files and a root-PID registry. A test script must demonstrate at least 3 concurrent jobs with peak active PIDs ≥ 3. The implementation must not touch existing code paths, and both scripts must parse cleanly.
summary: Add three new functions to lib/parallel.ps1: Start-ReadOnlyAuditJob (launches CLI subprocess with temp files, captures root PID), a root-PID registry mechanism, and Get-ReadOnlyAuditPoolStatus (returns count of active root PIDs). Create tools/test-readonly-parallel.ps1 that runs ≥3 dummy jobs concurrently and verifies peak active PIDs ≥ 3. Existing worktree/merge code remains untouched.

decision_atoms.statement: Use a script-scoped synchronized hashtable as the root-PID registry
decision_atoms.reason: Provides thread-safe access for concurrent job tracking without external dependencies, suitable for PowerShell's single-threaded pipeline with background jobs
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Slightly less performant than a dedicated concurrent collection, but sufficient for the current 3-job threshold and simple to implement

decision_atoms.statement: Implement per-job temporary files using System.IO.Path.GetTempFileName() with a structured naming convention
decision_atoms.reason: Ensures isolation between jobs, prevents file collisions, and allows easy cleanup; standard .NET method is reliable
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Creates multiple temp files per job (input/output/error/result) which may clutter temp directory, but cleanup is handled by the job lifecycle

decision_atoms.statement: Capture root PID using System.Diagnostics.Process.Id from the started process
decision_atoms.reason: Directly obtains the OS-level process identifier without relying on PowerShell job infrastructure, ensuring accurate tracking
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Requires storing Process objects or PIDs separately from PowerShell jobs, adding slight management overhead

decision_atoms.statement: Place new functions in a clearly marked region at the end of lib/parallel.ps1
decision_atoms.reason: Physically separates new code from existing worktree/merge functions, reducing risk of accidental interference and making audit boundaries clear
decision_atoms.tradeoff: File grows longer, but the separation is explicit and maintainable

decision_atoms.statement: Test script uses Start-Sleep as dummy workload with staggered start times
decision_atoms.reason: Simple, deterministic way to create concurrent processes that overlap in time, ensuring peak PID count can be observed
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Test timing may be slightly platform-dependent, but sleep durations can be tuned for reliability

assumptions: lib/parallel.ps1 already exists and contains worktree/merge functions that must not be modified
PowerShell version 5.1 or later is available (supports classes and System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser)
The execution environment allows spawning subprocesses (no execution policy blocking)
Temporary file creation via .NET is permitted and the temp directory is writable
The test script will be run in an environment where at least 3 concurrent processes can be spawned

risks.risk: Root PID registry may contain stale entries if jobs terminate abnormally without cleanup
risks.mitigation: Implement a periodic cleanup mechanism in Get-ReadOnlyAuditPoolStatus that checks process existence before counting; document that registry is eventually consistent

risks.risk: Temporary file accumulation if job cleanup fails
risks.mitigation: Register a trap or finally block in Start-ReadOnlyAuditJob to clean up temp files on job completion; use a temp subdirectory with a unique session identifier for bulk cleanup

risks.risk: Test script may fail intermittently if system is under heavy load and processes don't overlap as expected
risks.mitigation: Use sufficiently long sleep durations (e.g., 5-10 seconds) and add retry logic or relaxed timing assertions in the test

minimal_version: Add Start-ReadOnlyAuditJob and Get-ReadOnlyAuditPoolStatus functions to lib/parallel.ps1 with a simple hashtable registry; create test script with 3 concurrent Start-Sleep jobs and a basic assertion on peak PID count.
advanced_version: Add comprehensive error handling, automatic stale PID cleanup, structured logging per job, a configurable concurrency throttle, and a Wait-ReadOnlyAuditJob function for job completion tracking. Test script includes edge cases (job failures, rapid start/stop, cleanup verification).
